emailAlert.subject: [Solace Mail] Store errors (S3/PG/FS)
emailAlert.body:
Stalwart reported store errors.

S3: %{store.s3-error}%
Unexpected: %{store.unexpected-error}%
PostgreSQL: %{store.postgresql-error}%
Filesystem: %{store.filesystem-error}%

Gatus also watches these counters on status.solace.onl (stalwart-error-counters).

eventAlert.eventMessage: [store-errors] Store errors — S3 %{store.s3-error}%, unexpected %{store.unexpected-error}%, postgres %{store.postgresql-error}%, fs %{store.filesystem-error}%

emailAlert.subject: [Solace Mail] SMTP concurrency limit exceeded
emailAlert.body:
Inbound/outbound SMTP hit the concurrency limit (%{smtp.concurrency-limit-exceeded}%).
Check load, connection storms, or tune SMTP limits.

emailAlert.subject: [Solace Mail] Calendar iTIP/alarm errors
emailAlert.body:
Calendar iTIP or alarm delivery failed.
iTIP errors: %{calendar.itip-message-error}%
Alarm failures: %{calendar.alarm-failed}%
Inspect Live Tracing for calendar events.

emailAlert.subject: [Solace Mail] Delivery queue backlog
emailAlert.body:
The message queue has %{queue.count}% messages pending.
Check the VPS relay, outbound DNS, and delivery connections.
